result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may assign without consent to affiliates and qualifying successors, IBM requires Customer consent for all assignments and may never assign to a Customer competitor, and no change-of-control termination right is added. It is professionally drafted and preserves the broader commercial intent. However, revising the continuing-liability sentence from Customer-only liability to liability for either assigning party is an additional substantive change not required by the playbook, so the redline is not strictly minimal.
